questions.question: Jané Winster set a database record (21/22 season, combined T20 + List A) with a value of 20. Which record is it?
questions.explanation: It's the record for 'Most Maidens', held by Jané Winster.

questions.question: At which ground did Heat record their 'Largest Win by Runs' (List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Kimberley Oval — largest win by runs of 375, against Dragons on 2011/03/12.

questions.question: Which South African provincial union has a team playing in the Women's Japan Premier League?
questions.explanation: A result of the partnership between Titans Cricket Union and Japan Cricket Association.

questions.question: In head-to-head T20 meetings, who has the edge, Iinyathi or Kei?

questions.explanation: It was at Willowmoore Park Main Oval, against Eastern Storm on 2026/03/08.
